articles.summary: Wheaton Precious Metals™ Corp. ("Wheaton" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that its Board of Directors has declared its third quarterly cash dividend payment for 2026 of US$0.195 per common share, an 18% increase from the third quarterly cash dividend declared in 2025. The third quarterly cash dividend for 2026 will be paid to holders of record of Wheaton common shares as of the close of business on August 20, 2026, and will be distributed on or about September 3, 2026.
